title: Zephyr: duty cycle tracker implementation
description: Duty cycle tracker for TX budget enforcement. AC: Tracks airtime per window, enforces limits.
notes: Completed the bounded Zephyr HAL duty-cycle tracker on top of the regional profiles. Added atomic non-blocking state protection with fail-closed contention semantics; atomic lichen_duty_cycle_try_record_tx admission so concurrent callers cannot oversubscribe; chronological monotonic-time tracking that rejects regression/u64 wrap; strict zero/invalid/capacity handling; saturating interval math; partial/full rolling-window expiry; and corrected next-availability calculation to expire from TX end rather than start. Raw record_tx remains available for completed-transmission accounting, while try_record_tx is the regulatory admission entry point. Validation: strict AppleClang C23 host CTest with UBSan 1/1 PASS; direct ThreadSanitizer 24-thread admission stress PASS (at most 9 x 4000ms EU admissions); five repeat host runs PASS; focused Zephyr qemu_x86 runtime 1/1 PASS; full HAL qemu_x86 suite 27 PASS/0 FAIL/6 hardware skips and PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL; Python canonical timing/vector tests 52/52 PASS; isolated Rust duty_cycle_vectors 2/2 PASS; ruff and diff-check PASS. Dirty L2 paths were not touched per orchestrator; the tracker exposes the integration-safe atomic admission API.
close_reason: Bounded, fail-closed, concurrent duty-cycle admission/accounting/expiry tracker implemented and validated with canonical vectors and Zephyr runtime.
